content: A majority vote of decision trees, each varied a little by random numbers (scikit-learn, 1 thread). trees is the number of trees, max_depth the limit on depth. Shows the accuracy, the time, a breakdown of the mistakes and an image of which pixels mattered, and passes predictions for every test image to compare.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Accuracy, CPU time, settings, and predictions for every test image
